messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the one-piece garment and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character turns and poses, raising one arm to touch her hair and then bringing her hand to her face while shifting her stance.","camera":"A static medium shot from behind and slightly to the side, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"She wears a tight, short-sleeved black-and-white checkered romper with a low open back.","hair_color":"Red.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled up into a high bun with a short red fringe across the forehead.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown from the back and side in a European-style street.","scene":"A cobblestone street lined with old stone and brick buildings, black lampposts, a hanging Union Jack flag, and a sign reading 'AUTOMOBILE HAIR & TUNING SALON'."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The original black off-shoulder top, black pants, and white apron were replaced by a tight black-and-white houndstooth one-piece romper with short sleeves and a low open back. The character's red hair, hairstyle, face, pose, and street scene remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the character's entire outfit with the reference one-piece houndstooth garment and brown shoes, removing all original clothing and footwear while preserving non-clothing attributes.
uncertain: Whether the reference garment's exact neckline and sleeve shape were fully matched, since the character is mostly shown from behind and side.
unexpected_changes: The reference outfit's brown shoes are not visible in the output; the lower legs appear bare or the footwear was not applied.
